en_title: Some Fans Seem to Think The Witcher 3 Remastered Looks Worse Than the Original in Official Comparison Clip
subtitle: 重制还是倒退？
opus_summary: 官方对比视频展示了《巫师3》原版与重制版的实机画面。部分玩家认为重制版虽然强化了盔甲细节和水面效果，但火焰倒影、雾效及部分纹理反而不如原版。重制版将于9月29日推出并支持继承存档。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3 fans have reacted to an official comparison clip featuring a snippet of side-by-side gameplay from the original game and the upcoming remaster, with some saying the new version actually looks worse.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3》粉丝对一段官方对比视频作出了回应。视频展示了原版游戏与即将推出的重制版的部分并排实机画面，有人认为新版的实际效果反而更差。

paragraphs.en: In the clip, you can see Geralt casting Igni on a group of drowners in the swamp, with a side-by-side comparison with the original game and the remaster. And while the new version of the game has much greater detail on Geralt's armor, along with much more defined water, the reflections seem to be divisive.
paragraphs.cn: 视频中可以看到，杰洛特在沼泽里对一群水鬼施放伊格尼法印，画面同时对比了原版游戏与重制版。新版为杰洛特的盔甲加入了丰富得多的细节，水面效果也更加清晰，但倒影的表现似乎引发了争议。
选择你的阵容——可得慎重。#TheWitcher3Remastered

paragraphs.en: In the original game, you can see some of the fire reflected in the brackish water underneath the drowners, even if it results in an orange-ish blur. That'd be a pretty low bar to clear with the ray tracing on offer in the remaster, but the clip doesn't show any reflection of the fire at all. The fog is also much different in the remaster. In the original, there are defined clouds of fog floating just above the ground, where the remaster takes a more atmospheric approach to the fog in the distance.
paragraphs.cn: 在原版游戏中，可以看到部分火焰倒映在水鬼下方的咸水中，尽管呈现出来的只是橙色的模糊光影。对于提供光线追踪效果的重制版来说，实现这种程度的表现应该并不难，但视频里完全看不到火焰倒影。重制版的雾效也有明显不同。原版中，地面上方漂浮着一团团清晰可见的雾气；重制版则更注重营造远处雾气的氛围感。

paragraphs.en: A lot of the differences between the two sides of this clip comes down to the remaster using ray tracing, where the original didn't have it. Fans have had mixed reactions to this clip regardless. X / Twitter user LeafusMaximus said "despite literally adding RT to the game you managed to post a pic with worse water reflections, worse fog effects, worse armor textures in some cases (the glove he keeps back towards the camera for example), the new drowner just look wetter, the old ones actually look scaly/mucky." While desugar_64 simply asked: "Are you sure you didn't swap the footage around?"
paragraphs.cn: 这段视频两边画面的许多差异，归根结底是因为重制版加入了光线追踪，而原版没有。不过，粉丝们对这段视频的反应依然褒贬不一。X用户LeafusMaximus表示：「你们明明给游戏加入了光线追踪，却发出了一张水面倒影更差、雾效更差，而且部分盔甲纹理也更差的图片（比如他背对镜头时露出的那只手套）。新版水鬼看起来只是更湿了，老版水鬼才真的有鳞片和污泥质感。」而desugar_64则直接问道：「你确定没有把画面顺序弄反吗？」

paragraphs.en: Luckily, if you don't like the new visual representation, you should be able to roll back to an earlier version of the build as long as you're playing on PC. I'm not sure if that option will exist on consoles, but if you really don't want your current install of The Witcher 3 to get this change, you can turn off automatic updates. If you are planning on upgrading to the remaster though, you will be able to carry over your save data when the game comes out on September 29.
paragraphs.cn: 好在，如果你不喜欢新版的视觉表现，只要是在PC上游玩，应该就能回退到更早的版本。我不确定主机平台是否也提供这一选项，但如果你实在不想让当前安装的《巫师3》获得这项改动，可以关闭自动更新。不过，如果你计划升级到重制版，游戏于9月29日推出时将支持继承存档。
